text: Replaced the page-wide Titles/Abstracts/Summaries/Full switch and the per-part −/+ with one Detail scale, Low · Medium · High · Raw, defined once in kinds.tsx (DETAIL) and used by both controls. A part that differs from the page level shows "only here" with a reset button, and choosing a page level clears every per-part override (useEffect in Zoom.tsx), so the two controls cannot disagree. Typecheck, the UI build, a Playwright check of the sync, and 57 bun tests pass; committed as 39a0d2c, not pushed.
